## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has a valid `Signed-off-by` line (DCO, `git commit -s`).
- [ ] Linters / pre-commit hooks pass (see `LINTING.md`).
- [ ] Tests pass, and new behavior is covered where practical.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or configuration changes.
- [ ] Any new dashboards or schemas follow the existing structure.
- [ ] AI-assisted changes were reviewed and understood; commits credit the
      assistant with `Assisted-by:`, never `Signed-off-by:`. See
      [Coding assistants and AI tools](../CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-assistants-and-ai-tools).

> **Security:** do not report vulnerabilities in a public PR — follow `SECURITY.md`.
